E01.title: 30 lines that turn a chatbot into an agent
E01.lead: A chat model can only write text. A loop of about 30 lines, with one bash tool, gets it to read files and run commands. Step through a real run and see exactly what goes to the model each round and what comes back.

E02.title: Give an agent 5 tools without changing the loop
E02.lead: Chapter 2 of learn-claude-code adds four tools, to read, write, edit and find files. The loop from episode 1 barely changes: it runs whatever tool name the model writes. Step through real runs and see which tool the model picks, step by step.

E03.title: Who stops an AI agent from running rm?
E03.lead: The model writes a command and the program runs it. Chapter 3 of learn-claude-code puts gates in between: a deny list that blocks without asking, and a check that stops and asks you first. Step through real runs and see each gate at work.
